about.text: (German for "whitewashed" due to the rind color) or Beer cheese is a type of cow's milk cheese that originated in Germany, but is now known worldwide. It is a pungent and salted surface-ripened cheese that starts out much like brick cheese.

sources.text: surface-ripened for about seven months in very humid conditions; EU PDO since 2015
